title: confed pull result
description: The `result` of `confed pull --json`. With --dry-run the lists describe what would have been written and `dry_run` is true.

created.description: Pages materialized for the first time.

updated.description: Pages overwritten from the server because there was nothing local to lose — and pages whose attachments or comments changed on the server while the page did not: those have `ops` of `"attachments"`, `"comments"` or both, and equal versions. For attachments, files in the sidecar were downloaded or removed and `confed.attachments` in the frontmatter rewritten; for comments, comments.md and the comment marks in the page body. The page's text is as it was.

conflicted.description: Diverged pages whose merge left conflict markers. The command exits 4.

deleted.description: Local files removed because the page is gone on the server.

moved.description: Files relocated because the page was renamed or re-parented on the server.

skipped_dirty.description: Pages pull refused to touch. Non-empty means the whole command failed with exit 7 unless --force was given.

attachments_downloaded.description: Attachment files written to sidecars: new ones, and new versions of ones already there.

attachments_removed.description: Local copies removed because the attachment was deleted on the server. A copy changed locally is kept, with a warning.

to_version.description: Base version after it; null for a deletion.

ops.description: Omitted on the pull side, which always rewrites the whole file — except for a page of which only the attachments, the comments, or both changed: `["attachments"]`, `["comments"]`, `["attachments", "comments"]`.
